title: 第37章 一拖二回村
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 李二牛往后退了三大步，后背死死抵在石灰剥落的墙皮上，两只手在衣服上蹭个不停，像是刚摸过什么脏东西。“医生，你这话说得……真不行了？”李二牛眼珠子乱转。老医生摘下眼镜，从兜里掏出一块发黄的麂皮布，慢条斯理地擦着镜片。他看惯了生离死别，脸上没啥波澜，所以只是摇摇头。“没用了，抬回去吧。要是离得近，还能赶在进门后咽气。”王大壮蹲在门板边上，原本还想伸手去扶一下张永福，听完这话，手猛地缩了回来，整个人像火烧屁股一样跳开。“刘烨，这事咱可说清楚了。队长让咱帮衬着送人来瞧病，咱出力了。可这人要是死在半道上，我可不抬。”王大壮一边说，一边把那块抬门板用的垫肩布扔在地上，“这活儿，就是给钱我也不干啊。沾了死人味，回家得倒大霉。”张国海趴在长凳上，听了医生这话，一下也没了主意。“阿福……我的儿啊……”张国海嚎了一嗓子，声调凄厉，却没见眼里有泪。他费劲地扭过头，看着地上那块门板，“医生，你再给瞧瞧，哪怕开点药，吊着命也行啊！不能就这么回去了，回去了他就真没了！”老医生把眼镜重新架回鼻梁，冷冷地看了张国海一眼。“开药？开药也是浪费钱？不如留着买口薄棺材。”刘烨一直没吭声。他看着门板上的张永福，脸色已经没有活人味了。“医生，要多少钱？”刘烨开口了，声音厚实，听不出情绪。“挂号两毛，检查费一块。要是想住院观察，一天得五块，还不算药费。”老医生上下打量着刘烨，“你有钱吗？”刘烨摸了摸裤兜，之前刘宇宁给的那二十块钱，后来他修农具用了三块，现在还有十七块。李二牛一听要钱，立马把兜翻了出来，比脸还干净。“刘大个，你别看我。我家啥情况你全知道，连买盐的钱都是现凑的。这钱，我是一个子儿都没有。”王大壮也跟着摆手，“我也没钱。再说了，这钱借给张家，跟扔进水里没两样。国海叔，你也别怪我说话难听，你家那情况，谁敢借钱给你？”张国海趴在凳子上，眼神闪烁。张家也没钱！“刘烨……要不你先给垫上。等回了村，让你婶子还你。”张国海厚着脸皮开口，“你总不能看着阿福就这么死在卫生院门口吧？”刘烨没接话，他转头看向老医生，“医生，张叔这腰，能治吗？”“不好说，只能试试看。得先正骨，还得贴膏药，卧床养着。”老医生指了指张国海，“但他这岁数，要是治不好，以后就只能在床上拉撒了。”张国海一听自己也要瘫，吓得魂飞魄散。“治！治我！我不能瘫啊！”他大声叫唤起来，完全忘了地上躺着的亲儿子。李二牛和王大壮对视一眼，眼里全是嫌恶。“刘大个，咱走吧。这人也瞧了，医生也说了没治，咱的任务算完成了。”李二牛作势要走，“天快黑了，再不走，山路就不好走了。”“门板抬上，把人弄回去。”刘烨语气不容置疑。“我不抬！”王大壮嗓门拔高了，“要抬你一个人抬。这人眼看着就没气了，万一死在路上，我这辈子都得走霉运。我还没娶媳妇呢，不能沾这晦气。”李二牛也跟着帮腔，“就是。刘烨，你力气大，你行。我这身板不行，腰疼。我得赶紧回村给队长汇报情况去。”说完，李二牛拉着王大壮就往卫生院门口溜。“站住！”刘烨吼了一声。两人脚下一顿。“刘烨，你别仗着力气大就欺负人。咱是义务帮忙，没拿张家一分钱。现在医生都判了死刑，咱凭啥还得跟着受累？”李二牛回头喊了一句，“这门板咱也不要了，你爱咋整咋整！”两人一溜烟跑出了卫生院，跑得比兔子还快。卫生院的长廊里，只剩下刘烨、趴在凳子上的张国海，还有地上半死不活的张永福。老医生摇了摇头，叹了口气，转身进了药房。“刘烨……你别管他们。”张国海在凳子上哼唧。“你背我回去，阿福……阿福就让他在这儿先待着，等回头让你婶子带钱来接他。”这话说得，连外人都听不下去。张永福脖子断了，一口气吊着，留在这儿等死？刘烨走到门板边，蹲下身。张永福的眼睛微微睁开一条缝，那眼神里没有求生的欲望，只有一股子让人发毛的死气。“叔，钱我垫上。先给你正骨。”刘烨站起身，去药房交了钱。十七块钱，交了五块。老医生拿着几张黑乎乎的膏药出来，又喊了个学徒，两人合力给张国海把错位的腰骨正了回去。“啊——！”张国海的惨叫声传遍了整个卫生院。正完骨，贴上膏药，张国海出了一身虚汗，整个人脱了水似的。“行了，带回去养着吧。这几天别乱动。”老医生交代完，又看了一眼地上的张永福，“这小子，我也给他扎两针，能不能撑到家，看他造化。”刘烨没说话，他把张国海重新扛在肩上。他把张国海扛到卫生院门口，放在一棵老槐树底下。“你在这儿等着。”刘烨折返回去，把张永福抱了出来。张永福这会儿已经没动静了，只有胸口那点细微的起伏，证明还活着。刘烨也不知道从哪里弄来两个麻袋，一番撕扯后，弄成了一个背带，把张永福挂在胸口。“刘烨……你真要把他弄回去啊？”张国海坐在树底下，看着儿子那副死相，心里也犯嘀咕。“这要是死在家里，还得花钱办丧事。咱家……哪还有钱啊。”刘烨冷冷地看了他一眼，“他是你儿子。”“儿子……儿子也得活人才算儿子，死人就是个债。”张国海嘟囔着，“我看他这样，悬了。要不，咱把他留在这儿，镇上公安会管的。”刘烨没理他，直接把张国海背到背上。他就这样，一前一后，背着两父子往回走。路还没走一半，天色就完全暗了下来。山路上的风带着哨音，吹得人心慌。张国海在刘烨的身后颠簸。他一会儿觉得身后冷，一会儿觉得脚底下凉，嘴里不停地念叨。“刘烨，你慢点。我这腰……哎哟。”“闭嘴。”刘烨闷声回了一句。他现在就想快点回去。天色渐渐暗了下来，这一趟回程，看来要摸黑。张永福突然剧烈地咳嗽起来。“咳……咳咳……”张国海吓得一个激灵。“阿福！阿福你还好吗？”刘烨停下脚步，把胸前后背的父子轻轻放在地上。张永福大口大口地喘着气，眼睛瞪得滚圆，死死地盯着上方的树冠。他的手在门板上抓挠着，指甲抠进了木头缝里。“水……水……”张永福喉咙里挤出两个字，微弱得几乎听不见。刘烨从腰间解下水壶，喂到他嘴边。张永福喝了两口，全顺着脖子流了下来。他突然一把抓住了刘烨的手，力气大得惊人。“徐……徐喜弟……”张永福眼里射出一股凶光，那是临死前的回光返照。“你个……贱人……”刘烨眼神一沉，他看着张永福，没说话。“你敢怀……野种……”张永福断断续续地说着，嘴角流出白沫，“我……一定要捶死……”刘烨握着水壶的手紧了紧。眼前的这个男人，哪怕到了这会儿，心里想的还是怎么折磨那个伺候他这么多年的女人。刘烨伸出手，轻轻地拨开了张永福抓着他的手指。“你回不去了。”刘烨轻声说。张永福愣了一下，眼神涣散开来。“我要……回家……我要弄死她……”话没说完，张永福脑袋一歪，最后一口气顺着喉咙眼儿散了。林子里瞬间安静得可怕。张国海坐在一边，有些不敢看，“刘烨，咋样了？阿福说啥了？”刘烨站起身，拍了拍手上的土。“没了。”张国海吓得半晌没动弹。“没了……真没了？”他这才伸手在儿子鼻尖探了探，猛地缩回手，嚎啕大哭起来。“我的儿啊！你怎么就这么狠心，撇下爹走了呀！”哭声在空旷的山谷里回荡，惊起了一阵宿鸟。刘烨看着地上的尸体，心里没有悲伤，反而觉得有一种说不出的轻松。这个禁锢了喜弟这么多年的枷锁，终于断了。“别嚎了。”刘烨忍不住长长吁了一口气，“再嚎，天亮也回不去。”“刘烨……这可咋整？死在路上了，进不了村啊！”张国海抹着眼泪，心里算计的全是规矩。“村里老辈人说，死外头的不能进村，得在村口停灵，还得请道士做法，这得多少钱啊！”“那是你的事。”
content_en: Li Erniu took three big steps back, his back firmly pressed against the peeling plaster wall, and his hands kept rubbing on his clothes, as if he had just touched something dirty."Doctor, what you said...are you really going to die?" Li Erniu's eyes rolled around.The old doctor took off his glasses, took out a piece of yellowed chamois cloth from his pocket, and wiped the lenses slowly.He was used to seeing separation between life and death, and there was no emotion on his face, so he just shook his head."It's no use, just carry it back. If you are close, you can die before entering." Wang Dazhuang squatted beside the door panel. He originally wanted to reach out to help Zhang Yongfu. After hearing this, his hand suddenly retracted, and his whole body jumped away as if his buttocks were on fire."Liu Ye, let's make this clear. The captain asked us to help send someone to see a doctor, and we did our best. But if this person dies on the way, I won't lift him." Wang Dazhuang said, throwing the shoulder pad used to lift the door panel on the ground. "I won't do this job even if you pay me. If it smells like death, it will be bad luck to go home." Zhang Guohai lay on the bench, and after hearing the doctor's words, he lost his mind."Afu...my son..." Zhang Guohai howled, his tone was sad, but there were no tears in his eyes.He turned his head with difficulty and looked at the door panel on the ground. "Doctor, please take another look. Even if you prescribe some medicine and hang your life, it will be fine! We can't just go back. He will be gone if he goes back!" The old doctor put his glasses back on the bridge of his nose and gave Zhang Guohai a cold look."Prescribing medicine? Prescribing medicine is a waste of money? Why don't you save it and buy a thin coffin." Liu Ye remained silent.He looked at Zhang Yongfu on the door panel, his face no longer lifelike."Doctor, how much does it cost?" Liu Ye spoke, his voice thick and emotionless."Two cents for registration and one yuan for examination. If you want to be hospitalized for observation, you will get five yuan a day, not counting the cost of medicine." The old doctor looked Liu Ye up and down, "Do you have money?" Liu Ye touched his trouser pocket. Of the twenty yuan Liu Yuning gave him before, he later used three yuan to repair farm tools, and now he still has seventeen yuan.When Li Erniu heard that he wanted money, he immediately took out his pocket and found that he was cleaner than his face."Big Brother Liu, don't look at me. You know everything about my family. Even the money to buy salt is collected in cash. I don't have a penny of this money." Wang Dazhuang waved his hand, "I don't have any money either. Besides, lending this money to the Zhang family is just like throwing it into the water. Uncle Guohai, don't blame me for speaking badly. With your family's situation, who would dare to lend you money?" Zhang Guohai lay on the stool, his eyes twinkling.The Zhang family doesn’t have any money either!"Liu Ye... why don't you put it on the bed first. When you get back to the village, let your aunt return it to you." Zhang Guohai said shamelessly, "You can't just watch Ah Fu die in front of the health center, right?" Liu Ye didn't answer. He turned to the old doctor, "Doctor, Uncle Zhang's waist can be cured."It's hard to say. We can only give it a try. We have to fix the bone first, and we have to apply plaster and stay in bed."The old doctor pointed at Zhang Guohai, "But at his age, if he can't be cured, he will have to defecate in bed."Zhang Guohai was scared to death when he heard that he was going to be paralyzed."Heal! Heal me! I can't be paralyzed!" He shouted loudly, completely forgetting about his own son lying on the ground.Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang looked at each other with disgust in their eyes."Big Liu, let's go. This man has also seen it, and the doctor has said that he can't be cured. Our mission is completed." Li Erniu made a gesture to leave. "It's getting dark. If we don't go, the mountain road will be difficult to walk." "Lift the door panel and get the person back." Liu Ye's tone was unquestionable."I won't lift him!" Wang Dazhuang's voice rose. "I have to lift him alone. This man is losing his breath. If he dies on the road, I will be unlucky for the rest of my life. I haven't married yet, so I can't take advantage of this bad luck." LiErniu also joined in, "That's right. Liu Ye, you are strong, you can do it. I'm not strong enough and my back hurts. I have to go back to the village quickly to report the situation to the team leader." After saying that, Li Erniu took Wang Dazhuang and slipped towards the entrance of the health center."Stop!" Liu Ye shouted.The two of them paused."Liu Ye, don't bully others just because you are strong. We are helping out voluntarily, and we have not taken a penny from the Zhang family. Now that the doctor has sentenced us to death, why should we have to suffer?" Li Erniu turned around and shouted, "We don't want this door panel anymore, you can fix it as you like!" The two of them ran out of the health center in a hurry, running faster than a rabbit.In the corridor of the health center, only Liu Ye, Zhang Guohai, who was lying on a stool, and Zhang Yongfu, who was half-dead on the ground, were left.The old doctor shook his head, sighed, and turned around and entered the pharmacy."Liu Ye...don't worry about them." Zhang Guohai grunted on the stool."You carry me back, Ah Fu... Ah Fu, let him stay here for now, and when you get back, ask your aunt to bring money to pick him up." This was said so well that even outsiders couldn't bear to hear it.Zhang Yongfu's neck was broken and he was left hanging here to die?Liu Ye walked to the door and squatted down.Zhang Yongfu's eyes opened slightly, and there was no desire to live in his eyes, only a breath of death that made people cringe."Uncle, I'll put the money in advance. I'll set your bones first." Liu Ye stood up and went to the pharmacy to pay the money.Seventeen yuan, I paid five yuan.The old doctor came out with some dark plasters and called an apprentice. The two worked together to straighten Zhang Guohai's dislocated waist bones."Ah——!" Zhang Guohai's screams spread throughout the health center.After setting the bones and applying plaster, Zhang Guohai broke out in a sweat, as if he was dehydrated."Okay, take it back and keep it. Don't move around these days." After the old doctor finished explaining, he glanced at Zhang Yongfu on the ground, "I'll also give him two injections. Let's see if he can make it home." Liu Ye didn't say anything, and he put Zhang Guohai on his shoulders again.He carried Zhang Guohai to the entrance of the health center and placed him under an old locust tree."Wait here." Liu Ye turned back and took Zhang Yongfu out.Zhang Yongfu was no longer moving at this moment. Only the slight rise and fall of his chest proved that he was still alive.Liu Ye didn't know where he got two sacks from, and after tearing them apart, they made a sling and hung Zhang Yongfu on his chest."Liu Ye... do you really want to take him back?" Zhang Guohai sat under the tree, looking at his son's dead look, and murmuring in his heart."If he dies at home, he will have to spend money on a funeral. How can our family... have any money?" Liu Ye glanced at him coldly, "He is your son." "Son... a son must be alive to be considered a son, and a dead person is a debt." Zhang Guohai muttered, "I think he is like this. Otherwise, let's leave him here, and the town police will take care of it." Liu Ye ignored him and directly carried Zhang Guohai on his back.He just walked back, one behind the other, carrying the two fathers and sons on his back.Before we were even halfway through the journey, it became completely dark.The wind on the mountain road carries a whistle, which makes people panic.Zhang Guohai bumped behind Liu Ye.Sometimes he felt cold behind him, and sometimes he felt cold under his feet, and he kept mumbling."Liu Ye, slow down. My waist... Ouch." "Shut up." Liu Ye replied in a muffled voice.He wanted to go back quickly now.The sky was getting dark, and it looked like the return trip would be dark.Zhang Yongfu suddenly coughed violently."Cough...cough..." Zhang Guohai was so frightened that he shivered."Ah Fu! Ah Fu, are you okay?" Liu Ye stopped and gently placed the father and son on his chest and back on the ground.Zhang Yongfu gasped for air, his eyes widened, staring at the tree crown above.His hands scratched at the door panel, his nails digging into the cracks in the wood."Water...water..." Zhang Yongfu squeezed out two words from his throat, so faint that he could hardly hear them.Liu Ye took off the kettle from his waist and fed it to his mouth.Zhang Yongfu took two sips, and all of it flowed down his neck.He suddenly grabbed Liu Ye's hand with surprising strength."Xu...Xu Xidi..." Zhang Yongfu's eyes shot out a fierce light, which was the flash of light before his death."You... bitch..." Liu Ye's eyes darkened. He looked at Zhang Yongfu and said nothing."You dare to conceive... a bastard..." Zhang Yongfu said intermittently, foaming at the corner of his mouth, "I... will beat you to death..." Liu Ye's hand holding the kettle tightened.The man in front of him, even now, is still thinking about how to torture the woman who has served him for so many years.Liu Ye stretched out his hand and gently opened Zhang Yongfu's fingers."You can't go back." Liu Ye said softly.Zhang Yongfu was stunned for a moment, his eyes widened."I want... to go home... I want to kill her..." Before he could finish his words, Zhang Yongfu tilted his head and his last breath went down his throat.The forest became eerily quiet for a moment.Zhang Guohai sat aside, afraid to look, "Liu Ye, how's it going? What did Ah Fu say?" Liu Ye stood up and patted the dirt on his hands."No more." Zhang Guohai was so frightened that he didn't move for a long time."It's gone...really gone?" He then reached out and touched the tip of his son's nose, then suddenly retracted his hand and burst into tears."My son! How could you be so cruel and leave your father behind?" The cry echoed in the empty valley, startling the birds for a while.Liu Ye looked at the corpse on the ground. He felt no sadness in his heart. Instead, he felt an indescribable sense of relief.The shackles that had imprisoned Xidi for so many years were finally broken."Stop howling." Liu Ye couldn't help but let out a long breath, "If you howl any more, you won't be able to go back until dawn." "Liu Ye... what's going to happen? He died on the road and couldn't enter the village!" Zhang Guohai wiped away his tears, all he was planning in his mind was the rules."The elders in the village said that those who died outside could not enter the village. They had to leave their bodies at the entrance of the village, and they had to ask a Taoist priest to perform the ritual. How much does it cost?" "That's your business."
